name: run-branches-deliver
description: Implement the approved run-branches design, validate with full unit and e2e tests, review with two independent reviewers, and loop until the aggregated verdict approves.

If Playwright browsers are missing or the e2e suite cannot start for environmental reasons, record that precisely as `blocked` with the error; do not install anything. Also confirm `git -C /Users/thiagosbrito/personal/code-factory log -1 --format=%h` is still 044acbf (no commits were made) and list changed files from `git status --short`.
